quests.title: Echoes of the Unknown Gate
quests.summary: Uncover the ancient harmonic mystery linking the Crossroads, the Heart Tree, and the sealed Unknown Gate at the frontier.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Maren at the Crossroads Settlement
Journey west and discover The Ancient Heart Tree
Awaken the Singing Obelisk puzzle in the valley ruins
Attune 3 Regional Waystones across the realm
Discover The Unknown Gate in the Hidden Frontier

quests.title: Awakening the Unknown Gate
quests.summary: Confront the Gatekeeper Automaton in the Hidden Frontier, claim its Aether Core, and awaken the monumental Unknown Gate.

objectives.text: Defeat the Elder Stone Warden guarding the frontier
Awaken The Unknown Gate portal with the Resonance Key

quests.title: Sovereigns of the Shattered Age
quests.summary: Now that the Gate resonates, vanquish the mighty regional guardians of Highland Reach and the Shattered Expanse.

objectives.text: Vanquish the Glacier Sovereign in Highland Reach
Vanquish the Astral Leviathan at the Broken Horizon

quests.title: Charting the Frontier Gates
quests.summary: Journey to the distant perimeter monuments marking the 15x15 km outer frontier beyond the 8 playable regions.

objectives.text: Discover all 8 Major Regional Landmarks
Explore 4 Ancient 3D Sanctuaries across the world

quests.title: Herbs of the Emerald Canopy
quests.summary: Herbalist Lyra seeks luminous Moonpetals and Golden Sunberries to brew traveling tonics.

objectives.text: Gather Golden Sunberries (3)
Gather Silver Moonpetals from the forest edge (2)
Report back to Herbalist Lyra

quests.title: Forge of the Old Kingdom
quests.summary: Blacksmith Torin can teach you to craft ancient weaponry once you recover sentinel parts and crystals.

objectives.text: Defeat a Stone Sentinel or Bramble Stalker
Collect Resonant Crystal Shards (2)
Craft any item or meal via Inventory -> Crafting

quests.title: Sails of the Azure Coast
quests.summary: Harbormaster Kael at Tidehaven Harbor challenges you to sail across Azure Coast and dive for a Sunken Pearl near the Drowned Archive.

objectives.text: Take the helm of a Sailboat on Azure Coast
Discover The Drowned Archive
Recover a Drowned Archive Pearl from the seabed

quests.title: Ascent of the Skywatch Peaks
quests.summary: Alpine Guide Soren at Frostcrest Basecamp asks you to gather Frostblooms and climb to the rotating Skywatch Observatory.

objectives.text: Harvest Highland Frostblooms (2)
Reach The Skywatch Observatory

quests.title: Angler of the Silver Waters
quests.summary: Cast your glowing Spirit Line along rivers, coves, and alpine tarns to land fresh regional catches.

objectives.text: Catch 3 Fish using the Spirit Fishing Line (Press F near water)

quests.title: Bond of the Wind Stag
quests.summary: Call Sylph the Spirit Wind Stag (Press H outdoors) and channel Resonance Magic across the open hills.

objectives.text: Summon and ride Sylph the Wind Stag (Press H)
Cast 3 Ancient Resonance Spells (Keys 1-4)

quests.title: Flames of the Traveling Hearth
quests.summary: Rest beside any regional campfire to advance day into dawn or dusk and prepare warm journey rations.

objectives.text: Rest at a Crossroads or Outpost Campfire
Cook a meal at the Campfire or Crafting Bench

quests.title: Secrets of the Brass Astrolabe
quests.summary: Step inside the hidden Skywatch Astrolabe Sanctum high in Highland Reach and inspect its celestial instruments.

objectives.text: Enter the Skywatch Astrolabe Sanctum

quests.title: Crypt of the Silent Citadel
quests.summary: Descend into the Silent Citadel Crypt beneath the Forgotten Kingdom ruins and claim the ancient royal seal.

objectives.text: Enter the Silent Citadel Crypt
Vanquish the Mossback Colossus

quests.title: Fallen Stars & Wandering Traders
quests.summary: Track down a fallen Meteoric Starfall Shard or follow a guiding Spirit Wisp in the wilds.

objectives.text: Complete a Dynamic World Event (Starfall or Spirit Wisp)

quests.title: The Cartographer's Horizon
quests.summary: Chart the diverse regions of the 8x8 km realm and uncover ancient landmarks & environmental puzzles hidden across the continent.

objectives.text: Discover 4 Major Regional Landmarks
Solve 3 Ancient Environmental Puzzles

quests.title: Secrets of the Hidden Sanctuaries
quests.summary: Venture inside ancient enclosed sanctuaries across the realm — Elder's Hall, Crystal Vault, Drowned Archive, Astrolabe Sanctum, and more.

objectives.text: Enter 2 Interior Sanctuaries or Halls
Vanquish a Legendary Regional Guardian Boss

quests.title: Grace of the Perfect Parry
quests.summary: Master Wayfarer defense and stealth tactics against hostile guardians across the continent.

objectives.text: Land a Perfect Shield Parry or Stealth Ambush
Defeat 5 Hostile Creatures across the realm

quests.title: Chronicler of the Unknown World
quests.summary: Uncover ancient lore tablets and sanctuary charters to fill the Wayfarer's Codex (Press B).

objectives.text: Record 3 Ancient Lore Entries in the Codex
